screening_summary.reviewed_method: All 250 names received a preliminary title/sector screen; selected Prague office addresses, IČO and registered activities were corroborated in published commercial-register notices. Not all 250 firms were independently researched.
screening_summary.warning: No listed candidate has a verified active Prague trading location, buyer budget, official website absence or redesign need. These are research leads, not approved pitches. Do not falsely match unrelated same-name websites.
